agreement: Maintainer, 3 Nov 2026: 14:40 agreement to recompile MoltenVK or replace its kept binary; 15:04 go-ahead for this workflow and its runs; 15:23 'keep the latest MoltenVK library, the most recent one'.
why: v1.4.2 (newest Khronos release) enables MTLResidencySet on iOS 18 (mvkOSVersionIsAtLeast(15.0, 18.0, 2.0), Apple6 GPUs) and defers useResource in deduplicated lists, which removes upstream the per-descriptor walk measured in 629; the RewindBox argument buffer patch written for 1.4.0 no longer applies and is retired. MVKConfiguration is unchanged from 1.4.0.
patchMarkers: RewindBox drawable ownership: taken by each present, guarded by _mtlDrawableLock
RewindBox cache size: entry sizes counted once and kept on each shader library
RewindBox mapped cache data: compressed MSL referenced in the mapped file, not copied
RewindBox cache load line: libraries read, MSL copied or referenced, pNext types seen
RewindBox cache keys: a cached library keeps the resource bindings a lookup reads, not the layout's table
patchWhy: MVKPresentableSwapchainImage drawable ownership (KhronosGroup/MoltenVK#2791, open, no upstream fix): acquireAndSignalWhenAvailable released _mtlDrawable without a lock on the vkAcquireNextImageKHR thread while, with MeloNX's asynchronous queue submission, the image's earlier present read it and copied it into its Metal handler blocks on the submission thread (SIGSEGV objc_retain <- _Block_copy <- MTLDispatchListAppendBlock <- presentCAMetalDrawable, Super Mario 3D World, vsync unbounded, IPA 718). Each present now takes its drawable under _mtlDrawableLock and its completion handler releases it; acquisition releases nothing; nextDrawable is never called with the lock held. Model and sanitizer checks: test/melonx_moltenvk_drawable_ownership_test.py. Also (lot 9, second part): MVKPipelineCache::countData() counts each entry's serialized size once and keeps it on its shader library, so the size query RewindBox asks during play no longer serializes every entry again (IPA 718 Hogwarts: 2 461 ms for 4 667 entries). macOS bench run 42811818840: 480 queries 24.6-24.9 ms -> 2.1-2.7 ms, same 8 826 110 bytes and data hash, VK_INCOMPLETE kept for a short buffer, reload size equal. Also (lot 9, third part, RAM): a private pNext structure of VkPipelineCacheCreateInfo (sType 0x52425831, 'RBX1') makes vkCreatePipelineCache reference each library's compressed MSL in the caller's data instead of copying it into the heap (MVKCompressor keeps an external pointer; MVKShaderLibrary's copy keeps it, so merges into main keep the reference; any new compression or a load without the structure owns its bytes as before; the cache data written is byte-identical). RewindBox passes it for the main snapshot only and keeps that read-only mapping until main is destroyed (adapt_pipeline_cache_mapped_data, Core gate pipeline-cache-mapped-data: the mapping kept through play, the pause checkpoint and the close, released after main is destroyed, every read of it valid). macOS bench run 42818483337 (44 MB cache, 2 400 pipelines): +77.8 MiB at load copied, +32.4 MiB referenced; 246 vs 199 MiB after the pipelines; same bytes written, 0 missing, 0 SPIR-V compiled. Not measured on an iPhone. Fourth part (11 Nov, lot 9, diagnostic only): one info line per pipeline cache loaded from data, "RewindBox pipeline cache load: N shader libraries from B bytes; compressed MSL copied|referenced in the caller's data; pNext types ...". IPA 724 (Hogwarts, pid 49375): the load meant to be referenced had the footprint curve of the copied load of IPA 718 (2 060 -> 4 149 -> 3 596 MiB against 2 090 -> 4 256 -> 3 678), and nothing in the journals said how the driver had taken the data. No behaviour change. Fifth part (11 Nov, lot 10, RAM and pipeline cache size): a cached shader library is kept under SPIRVToMSLConversionConfiguration::cacheKey(), its configuration without the resource bindings no lookup can read a result from (matches() reads the used bindings of the entry stage; alignWith() gives a binding the used flag of the last matching binding, false when none matches: an unused binding is dropped unless a used one before it matches it). MeloNX declares 261 bindings for a vertex + fragment program and MoltenVK lists each once per Metal stage with argument buffers: 1 305 entries of 136 bytes kept per library, in memory and in the data (IPA 724 Hogwarts: 792.03 MiB for 4 669 libraries, 177 876 bytes each; the staging load and its merge held them twice, +1 078 then +913 MiB in 5 s; a save rewrote them all, 10.9 s at the pause). The compressed MSL the third part references is the small rest, which is why Core 721 showed nothing on the device. Data written before is read whole and kept as keys; data written with keys is read by a MoltenVK without this part (same format). The load line gains "resource bindings R read K kept". MVK_CONFIG_REWINDBOX_FULL_CACHE_KEYS in the environment keeps whole configurations (the control of test/melonx_cache_keys; nothing sets it in the app). Property test on MoltenVK's own matches() and alignWith(): test/melonx_cache_keys/cache_key_property_test.cpp. Not measured on an iPhone.
